- Added `set_lane_type`/`get_lane_type`, with `lane_type_` defaulting to `LaneType::NONE` in both constructors.
- Added the standalone `create_lane_from_lane_width(LanePosition, geometry::Line previous_line, LaneWidth, float s_inc=0.5f)` returning a `LanePtr`. It offsets any given reference line (not just the plan view's) by the width polynomial, mirroring the existing `PlanView::create_line` offsetting logic but decoupled — so outer lanes can be built off their inner neighbor.

**`modules/world/opendrive/plan_view.hpp`** — `get_reference_line()` already existed; confirmed it returns `reference_line_`.

**`modules/world/opendrive/lane_section.{hpp,cpp}`** — Added `get_lane_by_position(LanePosition pos)`, searching lanes by their `lane_position_` (returns `nullptr`/`None` if absent).

- Bound `create_lane_from_lane_width` as a static method on `Lane` (with arg defaults).
- Exposed `lane_type` as a read/write property.

- Bound `get_lane_by_position` on `LaneSection`.

- Filters lanes by the supported types drawn from `LaneType.__members__` (case-insensitive), skipping unsupported types.
- Sets each lane's `lane_type` from the parsed XODR type string.
